persona: Apparel art director for independent labels; judges print-readiness, one-ink production and wearability at 3 m

designs.why: Clean, confident one-colour engraving: strong heavy-serif PASTA headline, tidy 4x4 grid with consistent label sizes, and line weight that is bold enough to survive screenprinting at 3 m. Crops show crisp strokes, solid blacks and no halftones or grey fills. Shapes are recognisable and the field-guide concept reads instantly. Weaknesses: the finest hatching (rotelle sidewall, orecchiette shading, radiatori tick marks) is dense and may fill in on a screen, and the 16 items are of uneven visual weight (spaghetti, rotelle and radiatori are heavy; ravioli and lasagne are airy). Some shapes, notably radiatori and campanelle, are a little ambiguous. The print is also large and busy for a shirt, with little breathing room at the sides.
designs.fix: Thin out and open up the finest hatching (rotelle sidewall, orecchiette shading, radiatori ticks) to a minimum stroke and gap that holds at screen-print mesh, and balance the visual weight across the 16 cells.
